name: Product Feedback Analyst
tagline: Gathers feedback from every source, clusters it, weighs it, drafts priorities
description: Collects product feedback from all of the connected sources, pulls the scattered asks into themes, scores each theme on evidence and urgency, then drafts a priority-ordered view the team can argue with. Roadmap debates start from a counted, sourced picture instead of whoever spoke loudest this week.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
